newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-Portugal spreads seen steady with Bunds.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Portugal spreads seen steady with Bunds.

text.p: The following is the daily forecast for spreads in the Portuguese bond market based on a poll of five banks.
The poll covers spreads between the February 2007 Portuguese
cash bond (OT) and the German and Spanish equivalents, together
with the spreads between the Portuguese 10 and two-year bonds.
Min spread Avge Max vs previous close
Key factors likely to affect market:

- The 10-year cash was expected to trade with little volatility ahead of the release of the U.S. economic growth figures for the first quarter. But there was little chance of any "upside" given the approach of the French elections and the dispute between the German government and the Bundesbank over the revaluation of gold reserves.
Note: YLDS3 is still calculated on basis of Feb 06 bond.
